CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Model Architecture]
- What: In model_design, add one pre-normalized causal self-attention residual layer after ConvRec’s four convolutional blocks, using two attention heads, hidden size 96, and dropout 0.25; update the predictor writer to reconstruct this same architecture from its checkpoint.
- Why: Content-dependent attention can retrieve relevant earlier purchases when intervening items are unrelated, complementing the convolutional backbone’s fixed temporal mixing within one jointly trained network.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: Dilated convolutions mix history through fixed offsets and cannot directly select earlier items according to the current sequence representation.
- Evidence: The convolutional model scores 0.4987 macro HR@10 versus the SASRec baseline’s 0.505, with Electronics falling from 0.42 to 0.36; this supports testing adaptive history retrieval, although it does not establish the cause of the regression.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Causal attention lets each position retrieve relevant preceding convolutional features while preserving autoregressive training; mask padding keys and explicitly handle all-padding query rows to prevent invalid attention outputs.
- Expected improvement: The hypothesis is improved Electronics HR@10 and macro HR@10 above 0.505, assessed through the unchanged host benchmark; these are experimental targets, not measured results.
- Synergy: Convolutions retain local sequence features while the added attention layer selects useful context, with all parameters optimized jointly under the existing ranking loss.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: Preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42.
- Data split: Identical supplied training and validation splits across all four categories; no access to hidden test files.
- Training: Existing prefix sampling, 256-negative sampled-softmax loss, token limit, AdamW settings, learning-rate schedule, batch size, epoch limit, checkpoint selection, and early stopping.
- Backbone: Existing convolutional blocks, item embeddings, learned item bias, hidden size, history length, and dropout settings.
- Evaluation: Macro-average validation HR@10, 200 users/category, 99 unique negative candidates, and evaluation seed 42; the host evaluator remains authoritative and unchanged.
- Inference: Exactly one independently trained model and one selected checkpoint per category, with unchanged dataset routing and identical sequence preparation for validation and host inference.
- Resources and artifacts: Single-GPU execution, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], artifacts beneath the trial directory, and the existing runtime cap.
